entities.summary: Kazimierz Dmochowski was a Roman Catholic archbishop of the Archdiocese of Mohilev from 1848 until his death in 1851. He previously served as auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Vilnius and titular bishop of Meloë from 1840 to 1848.
